title: Ethics and Responsibility in Agricultural Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand ethical concepts and standards in agricultural business.
Understand the relationship between agricultural businesses and society, and their responsibilities towards stakeholders.
Understand the nature of labor relations and human rights within businesses.
Understand the economic and legal aspects of agricultural businesses, international norms, and ethical conduct guidelines.
Apply ethical knowledge in various stages of agricultural production and supply.
Develop strategic orientation, organization, and implementation of ethical and responsible agricultural business activities.
Actively participate in policy development for ethical and responsible agricultural business.
Meet stakeholder needs as a business leader.
Recognize the role of agricultural businesses in contributing to society.
